title: walk.rs tests use '"1".to_string()' — prefer '.to_owned()'
description: walk.rs test assertions use vec\!["1".to_string()] — .to_string() on a string literal calls the Display impl and is slightly wasteful compared to .to_owned() which is the idiomatic form. Clippy lint: clippy::str_to_string. Fix: replace '"1".to_string()' with '"1".to_owned()' in all test assertions.
